text:
elaine: @channel quick kickoff for cloud store listing prep (AWS / GCP / Azure). want to align on packaging, legal artifacts, and infra handoffs. created a living checklist: https://bit.ly/rwd-cloud-listing-checklist — please shout with owners/constraints. :wave:

samir: i can own product packaging. rough asks: SKU naming, plan mapping (trial/dev/enterprise), trial length, and any usage limits for the trial. propose 14-day trial by default.

marta: legal heads up — we'll need EULA, DPA, SOC2 cert, and export control attestation. also need to know whether customers’ data is tenant-isolated or routed to our shared backend. if shared, we need customer-facing disclosures.

noah: ops notes — marketplace integrations need artifacts per cloud: AWS (AMI + listing manifest), GCP (GCR image + partner offer config), Azure (managed image / VM offer). also need IAM role policies for telemetry upload and license checks. I'll drop a sample terraform/module shortly.

priya: CS perspective — include a short trial onboarding playbook and email templates in the listing package. also a simple runbook for common onboarding issues (license activation, region limits). i'll draft templates.

devops-bot: pipeline created for publisher listing prep: pipeline-id=ci/publisher-listing-314159, status=created

samir: quick question: do we want separate SKUs per cloud or unify SKU and map in the catalog? unified SKU is simpler for marketing but some customers expect cloud-specific SKUs. thoughts? @noah @marta

noah: technically we can map a single logical SKU to cloud-specific artifacts in the pipeline. on AWS we still need AMI-per-region or shared AMI mapping. automated AMI copy is easiest.

marta: legal prefers single SKU where the terms are identical across clouds; if pricing differs we need explicit price mapping. also check marketplace-specific indemnity clauses (Azure sometimes has different reqs). i'll review the standard publisher agreement.

noah: example terraform snippet for the publisher module (for infra team reference):

```
module "publisher_marketplace" {
  source = "git::https://github.com/redwood/integration-terraform.git//marketplace-publisher"
  cloud  = "gcp"
  image  = "gcr.io/redwood/release:v1.2.0"
  sku    = "redwood-inference-dev"
}
```

elaine: summary / owners: Product = samir, Legal = marta, Ops = noah, CS = priya. i'll schedule a 30m sync to lock details. please drop availability. :calendar:

samir: tues/wed mornings work for me

marta: wed 2-4pm PT best

noah: any weekday after 10am PT works

priya: tues afternoon preferred

elaine: perfect — booking now and i'll attach the initial draft of the listing package to the calendar invite. owners — please add any must-have artifacts to the checklist link above before the sync. :thumbsup:
